subject.title: fix(codex): bound Computer Use process inspection

question: Should Codex Computer Use prefer a two-second bounded process snapshot that may defer stale-child cleanup over an unbounded readiness or health-check hang?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes the operational failure mode; tests and macOS proof show the implementation is safe, but the acceptable cleanup-versus-availability tradeoff is repository-owner intent.

options.title: Accept bounded fail-closed cleanup
options.body: Merge the two-second timeout, preserving the rule that incomplete process inspection never signals a child and allowing a later retry to clean it up.

options.title: Choose a different operational policy
options.body: Request an owner-approved timeout or retry policy if two seconds is not the desired availability-versus-cleanup balance.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded fail-closed cleanup
recommendation.body: Merge the two-second timeout, preserving the rule that incomplete process inspection never signals a child and allowing a later retry to clean it up.
